title: Top Earners Per Department Using Window Functions
prompt: Write a query using window functions to find the top 2 highest paid employees in each department. Return department_name, employee_name, and salary, ordered by department_name asc and salary desc.
reference_query:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT d.name AS department_name, e.name AS employee_name, e.salary,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) as rnk
    FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
)
SELECT department_name, employee_name, salary
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 2
ORDER BY department_name ASC, salary DESC;
